B leaves slightly more even breathing room, like the real bottle's margin at the top, while A pushes the cap loop and base closer to the edges.
A keeps the topiary as the single tall hero with little competing clutter, as in the real card, while B's bench, lamp, pot and foreground bushes compete with it.
Both ducks are about the same size, centered on the spring base, with similar margins and sand and background framing, so composition does not separate them.
